source_notes: Batch settings are explicit launcher profiles, not a proven mapping to each reported rounded value.
NoPE/XPos default to named legacy absolute-position compatibility; --correct-nope selects intended position-free behavior.
The user confirmed 200M was a post-paper change; the main experiment uses the paper budget of 100M tokens.
The sampler uses an independent saved seed/cursor; historical script RNG consumption is not asserted identical.
